text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It's finally starting... the first leg of the Triple Crown route.
A stage you only get once in a lifetime.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Once I leave this waiting room, there's no turning back.
I will stand in the paddock, and...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: —I will win the race, without fail.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I have high expectations for myself too.
Well then, I'm off.
(Wooooaaaah----!!)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...What a massive crowd.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
The Hopeful Stakes was all well and good, but
the Classics are on another level...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...It feels special in a whole different way.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Sky.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Man, that cheering is incredible!
The moment the young lady stepped out, everyone just went 'WAAAH!'"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
As expected of the top candidate for star of the year.
People sure have high hopes for you.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph, of course.
It would be unnatural if they didn't.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, even what she says sounds like a main character.
Haaah... So this is what a difference in caliber looks like.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I really drew the short straw. In my debut year's
Satsuki Sho, I ended up going against
King and Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Special Week is running
in this race too, I see.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah yeah! It totally feels like an all-star main character gathering!
It's really giving me a headache!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Haaah-ah, maybe this stage is a bit too grand
for a background character like me. *sniff*

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"There's no way just some background extra
could earn the right to run on such a grand stage."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Besides, it seems you managed to maintain your weight, condition, and everything else
before coming here, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha, King.
Aren't you overestimating me a bit?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, you talk a big game.
However...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: "No matter what chaotic factors are at play, the one who wins this race will be me, King Halo!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I need results.
...To make them acknowledge me.
